discription: A versatile synth generating a pulse waveform, shaped by an ADSR envelope, and further sculpted by a resonant low-pass filter. It allows control over frequency (freq), amplitude (amp), filter cutoff frequency (cutoff), and resonance quality (rq). The ADSR envelope (attack: 0.01, decay: 0.1, sustain: 0.8, release: 1.0) provides dynamic amplitude shaping, suitable for a wide range of sounds from pads to percussive elements.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Pulse.ar(freq);sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
